speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: asked the Minister for Law whether an undischarged bankrupt is required to seek approval from the Ministry of Law or the Insolvency and Public Trustee’s Office before they can file an employment dispute to the Tripartite Alliance for Disputes Management.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
text: I think this is this question emanated from a case which I encountered last month.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
text: And therefore, when he went and approached TADM, he was unable to take the matter further.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
text: I am hoping therefore to raise this, because this is quite ironical.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
text: The very fact that he is working as an undischarged bankrupt is to earn wages so that he can repay his debt.
